role_boundary: A-side only; current-CphiCollapse/B and B outputs were not read.
polaris: Test whether an independent input-side bilayer parity-transfer residual R_oe survives after measured non-superconducting baselines B_min are removed.
framework: Normal-state bilayer susceptibility decomposition with leakage-free residualization against measured input-side covariates.
findings: R_oe survives only as a candidate variable if a preregistered normal-state odd/even bilayer susceptibility ratio P_oe has a well-conditioned denominator, is extracted on a fixed temperature grid without Tc- or superconducting-output leakage, and retains matched-pair rank inversions after residualization against B_min. Survival is not claimed from existing literature; it is a go/no-go design for a same-sample pressure packet.
weakest_link: No same-sample pressure-series packet yet contains q_z-resolved odd/even susceptibility plus the full B_min baseline block; therefore R_oe is currently a candidate-variable definition and decision protocol, not a validated nickelate predictor.
next_plan: Acquire or assemble a same-sample pressure-row packet with P_oe and B_min measured before any superconducting-output labels are opened, then run blocked/shrinkage residualization and the matched-pair inversion test.
literature_needed: La3Ni2O7 pressure RIXS q_z bilayer form factor; high-pressure nickelate optical c-axis Drude weight; oxygen stoichiometry layer asymmetry nickelates; pressure path hysteresis La3Ni2O7; nickelate dz2 RE5d self-doping normal state

measurement_protocol.chi_definition: chi_channel(T,p) = integral_{omega_low}^{omega_high} S_channel(q_z,omega,T,p) / max(omega,omega_IR) d_omega after identical resolution, self-absorption, polarization-leakage, and background corrections for odd and even channels.

denominator_floor.rule: A pressure-temperature row is admissible only if abs(chi_odd + chi_even) >= D_floor.

terms.sigma_chi_sum: one-sigma propagated uncertainty of chi_odd + chi_even in chi_unit from counting statistics, fitting covariance, calibration transfer, and background subtraction
terms.B_chi: instrument background floor converted into chi_unit by applying the same intensity-to-chi calibration and energy-window integration used for chi_odd and chi_even
terms.median_abs_chi_sum_reference: median abs(chi_odd + chi_even) across admissible reference rows in the same sample packet, in chi_unit

denominator_floor.failure_handling: Rows below D_floor are denominator-censored and cannot be used for survival, collapse, or gray-zone decisions; they are reported separately as non-identifiable P_oe.

temperature_window_rule.allowed_rule: Use all preregistered grid temperatures that are experimentally in the normal state by protocol, without using same-row Tc_onset, zero resistance, Meissner response, diamagnetism, gap fits, spin resonance, or output-trained classifiers.
temperature_window_rule.forbidden_rule: Do not define the window as Tc_onset + delta for the same pressure row, and do not discard rows after seeing superconducting-output labels.
temperature_window_rule.normal_state_guard: If a material-specific historical phase diagram is used to justify the grid, it must be frozen before row ranking and cannot be updated with the packet's superconducting outcomes.
temperature_window_rule.window_stability_requirement: The sign of R_oe and the matched-pair inversion call must be unchanged between at least two of the three grid temperatures, including 150 K unless that row is denominator-censored.

B_min.principle: B_min contains only measured input-side covariates available before superconducting-output labels are opened. It must be distinct from tautological B_plus terms fitted from the same odd/even kernel.

covariates.name: oxygen_stoichiometry_and_layer_asymmetry
covariates.leakage_rule: Measured structurally or chemically, not inferred from Tc or superconducting volume fraction.

covariates.name: strain_and_lattice_context
covariates.leakage_rule: From diffraction or local structure at the same pressure-temperature row.

covariates.name: orbital_self_doping_block
covariates.leakage_rule: From normal-state spectroscopy only; no superconducting gap or resonance features.

covariates.name: dephasing_and_disorder
covariates.leakage_rule: Normal-state transport or spectroscopy above the frozen temperature grid.

covariates.name: c_axis_coherence
covariates.leakage_rule: Normal-state only; cannot use zero-resistance onset, diamagnetism, or any superconducting transition feature.

covariates.name: sample_quality
covariates.leakage_rule: Independent characterization, not selected by superconducting performance.

B_min.preprocessing: Each covariate is z-scored within the same sample packet using only admissible rows. Missingness indicators are included if imputation is used.

residualization.normalization: R_oe is dimensionless and may also be reported as Z_oe = R_oe / sigma_R_oe for thresholding.
model_order: preregistered blocked ridge regression using the seven B_min blocks
blocked nested cross-validation for N >= 12 and N < 20
no full survival/collapse call for N < 12 unless a single prespecified low-dimensional model with <= 3 effective degrees of freedom is used

negative_CV_R2_handling.rule: If CV_R2 < 0, report CV_R2 as baseline prediction failure and set R2_for_sigma = 0 for uncertainty propagation.
negative_CV_R2_handling.interpretation: Negative CV_R2 cannot be used as evidence that the independent signal is larger than the raw P_oe variance.

small_N_overfit_control.N_gray_design: 12 <= N < 20 permits only blocked shrinkage, nested tuning, and stability reporting; it cannot make a strong survival claim unless matched-pair criteria are met and coefficients are stable under leave-block-out analysis.
small_N_overfit_control.N_too_small: N < 12 is design-only. It may nominate pairs but cannot decide survival or collapse for the full B_min block.
small_N_overfit_control.effective_degrees_of_freedom_limit: edf <= floor(N_admissible/4) for any residualization model used in a decision call.
small_N_overfit_control.pair_independence: Matched pairs used for the inversion test must not be the same rows that determine a post-hoc covariate weighting; matching metric and calipers are frozen before seeing P_oe ranks.

required_conditions: All used rows pass the denominator floor.
Temperature/window rule is leakage-free and stable across at least two preregistered temperatures.
CV_R2 <= 0.65 for B_min, or 0.65 < CV_R2 < 0.85 with matched-pair inversion plus independent holdout replication.
At least two matched pairs show sign-stable rank inversion with abs(Z_oe) >= 2 for both members or abs(delta_R_oe_pair) >= 2*sigma_delta.
The residual rank inversion is not explained by any single B_min block under leave-one-block-out and leave-one-pair-out sensitivity.
N_admissible >= 20 for a full claim, or 12 <= N_admissible < 20 only for provisional candidate survival with shrinkage and holdout replication.
survival_table.allowed_claim: R_oe remains a candidate independent input-side bilayer parity-transfer residual in this packet.
survival_table.forbidden_claim: R_oe is validated as a universal predictor of superconductivity.

required_conditions: B_min predicts P_oe with CV_R2 >= 0.85 under nested or leave-row-out cross-validation.
mean_abs(R_oe) <= 0.5*sigma_P_oe and no row has abs(Z_oe) >= 2 after multiplicity control.
No matched pair shows a preregistered rank inversion after residualization.

Collapse remains under leave-one-block-out checks, or the responsible block is physically ordinary input-side baseline such as c-axis coherence, oxygen asymmetry, strain, disorder, pressure path, orbital self-doping, or sample quality.
survival_table.allowed_claim: P_oe carries no independent candidate-variable content beyond measured B_min in this packet.
survival_table.forbidden_claim: A universal no-go theorem is proven for all possible C_phi definitions.

required_conditions: 0.65 < CV_R2 < 0.85 without independent matched-pair inversion replication.
Only one matched pair inverts, or inversion is temperature-unstable.
Any major B_min block is missing or imputed in more than 20 percent of admissible rows.
Denominator censoring removes more than 25 percent of rows.
survival_table.allowed_claim: The packet is inconclusive; R_oe neither survives nor collapses.
survival_table.next_action: Add rows, repair missing B_min blocks, improve odd/even channel conditioning, and rerun the frozen protocol.

required_conditions: P_oe denominator floor fails for the relevant rows.
The temperature window uses same-row superconducting outputs.
B_min includes tautological odd/even kernel terms or output-trained labels.
N_admissible < 12 for full B_min and no prespecified <=3-edf fallback exists.

matched_pair_intervention_design.goal: Create or identify pairs with matched B_min but deliberately different independent P_oe/R_oe expectation, then ask whether R_oe predicts a rank inversion unavailable to ordinary baselines.

matching_rule.covariate_space: z-scored B_min blocks excluding P_oe and superconducting outputs
matching_rule.decision_pairs: At least 2 pairs must independently pass inversion criteria for candidate survival.

intervention_axes.example: compare pressure or strain rows where bilayer spacing/form-factor shifts odd/even spectral transfer while B_min remains within calipers
intervention_axes.independent_prediction: P_oe and R_oe rank row i above row j despite matched c-axis coherence and sample-quality baselines

intervention_axes.example: loading versus unloading rows matched in oxygen, strain, f_D, and disorder but differing in odd/even susceptibility redistribution
intervention_axes.independent_prediction: R_oe reverses the baseline rank produced by B_min-only E_hat[P_oe | B_min]

matched_pair_intervention_design.rank_inversion_definition: For a matched pair (i,j), B_min predicts abs(E_hat_i - E_hat_j) <= 0.5*sigma_delta or predicts E_hat_i <= E_hat_j, while measured residuals satisfy R_oe_i - R_oe_j >= 2*sigma_delta with the same sign at two preregistered temperatures.
matched_pair_intervention_design.holdout_rule: The pair nomination, calipers, and inversion sign must be frozen before superconducting-output labels are opened; superconducting output can only be inspected after the R_oe survival call, and only as downstream exploratory context.

claims.statement: A leakage-free P_oe can be defined as a dimensionless odd/even bilayer susceptibility imbalance only when chi_odd and chi_even are extracted in identical calibrated units and the chi_sum denominator exceeds a chi_unit floor.

limits.desc: equal odd and even susceptibility gives no parity imbalance

variables.median_abs_chi_sum_reference: same-packet reference median abs chi_sum, chi_unit

limits.desc: noise-free limit is still bounded by calibrated background and reference-scale floors

assumptions: Odd and even channels are extracted with identical resolution and calibration conventions.
Background intensity is converted to chi_unit before entering the denominator floor.
Rows failing the floor are censored rather than regularized into artificial P_oe values.

claims.statement: R_oe is a candidate independent variable only if residualized P_oe survives measured B_min without using superconducting-output leakage.

variables.E_hat_P_oe_given_B_min: cross-validated prediction of P_oe from B_min

variables.sigma_P_oe: uncertainty or packet-scale standard deviation of P_oe, dimensionless
variables.CV_R2: cross-validated R2 of B_min predicting P_oe

limits.desc: negative CV_R2 is clipped to zero for uncertainty propagation
perfect baseline prediction leaves no residual variance

assumptions: B_min covariates are measured before superconducting-output labels are opened.
Residualization model complexity is controlled by nested cross-validation or blocked shrinkage.
Gray-zone CV_R2 is inconclusive unless independent matched-pair inversion replication is present.

inspector_check.formula: P_oe = (chi_odd - chi_even)/(chi_odd + chi_even); R_oe = P_oe - E_hat[P_oe | B_min]
inspector_check.direction: If B_min explains P_oe, R_oe collapses to zero; if parity-transfer information remains, R_oe can produce matched-pair rank inversions despite matched baselines.
inspector_check.data: Requires same-sample normal-state pressure rows with q_z/polarization/form-factor odd-even susceptibility and B_min covariates; existing stitched literature is design support only.
inspector_check.assumptions: Fixed temperature grid, denominator-censored rows, non-tautological B_min, no superconducting-output leakage, and small-N overfit controls.
